import sys

def dot_product(a, b):
    res = 0
    for i in range(5):
        res += a[i] * b[i]
    return res > 0

def equal_vectors(a, b):
    for i in range(5):
        if a[i] != b[i]:
            return False
    return True

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n <= 11:
        points = []
        for _ in range(n):
            point = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(5)]
            points.append(point)
        
        vectors = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(5):
                    vectors[i][j][k] = points[j][k] - points[i][k]
        
        bad_indices = set()
        for i in range(n):
            flag = False
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    if not equal_vectors(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) and dot_product(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]):
                        bad_indices.add(i+1)
                        flag = True
                        break
                if flag:
                    break
        
        good_count = n - len(bad_indices)
        print(good_count)
        for i in range(n):
            if (i+1) not in bad_indices:
                print(i+1)
    else:
        print(0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
